title: Known semantic state versus local operator condition
summary: KnownTerminalState identifies host/application semantics; operator-error state describes the local keyboard/cursor condition. Moving into protected space does not create a new semantic host state.
invariants: Known-state matchers should ignore transient cursor placement unless semantically required.
PRE_HELP_ERROR/PROTECTED_AREA may coexist with the same IBM_I_CHANGE_PASSWORD state.
Automation requires unique semantic matching before sensitive action.

provenance.claim: Supports this Terminal Machine/TN5250 continuity article.
